issue: readCaps derives maxFrontierNodes as floor(maxIterations/2), a value below the depth-1 seed the same function admits: the shipped configs give 5 (research, maxIterations 10) and 3 (review, maxIterations 7), while ROOT_CHILDREN_FLOOR/maxRootChildren on line 247 admit 6 and 8. The seed is exempt from the run cap only while `seeding` is true, and every seed still counts in countLiveNodes (line 149, which excludes only 'pruned'), so the first depth-2 proposal is pruned 'fanout' (line 353) and renderFrontierBlock computes zero slots (lines 537-540) and tells the leaf 'This node has no child slots left'. Case: `frontier-admit.cjs seed` with the shipped deep-research-config.json (4-6 sub-questions) or deep-review-config.json (up to 8 sub-targets), then any leaf frontier_proposal under a depth-1 node. Result: no depth-2 node is ever admitted, so expansiveDepth.maxDepth 3 and the budgetSplit depth2/depth3 bands, documented in deep-research/README.md, deep-research/references/convergence/convergence.md and deep-review/SKILL.md, cannot take effect at the shipped defaults; a review run is depth-1-only regardless of seed size, and the block attributes a run-wide cap to the node. The fix is a design decision: derive the run cap as at least maxRootChildren, or exempt seed nodes from countLiveNodes, and name the constraint the block reports.
